lines.en: : Hey, Molly. What are you up to?
: Afternoon, Sir!
: I decided to be adventurous this fine evening and journey outside of my room.
: Oh, really? Are you going somewhere?
: Negative, Sir. This is as far as I am willing to go.
: In order to break the NEET mold, I must stand in this very hallway for at least an hour once a week.
: What a coincidence that you just happened to show up on that very day!
: I mean, I show up on other days too. I don’t think it’s that strange of a coincidence.
: Tell me, Sir. Do you believe in fate?
: I feel like I’ve answered this question for someone else before.
: I believe, Sir. I believe we were fated to meet in this very hallway.
: This is a gift from the Heavens above! Or the Hells below! Whichever you believe in!
: And if we don’t believe in either?
: Then find something to believe in!
: Or better yet, believe in me!
: Oh! Even better than that-
: Believe in the me that believes in you!
: Molly, what the fuck are you even talking about?
: I JUST SHOTGUNNED A MONSTER AND I’M READY TO KICK ASS! LET’S GO!
: If you’re going to ask someone to believe in you instead of heaven or hell, you’re going to need better reasoning than “I just shotgunned a monster.”
: Let’s face it, Sir. You’ll believe in Molly MacCormack whether she gives you a good reason or not.
: And why is that?
: Because cute girls are more powerful than God! Especially ones with green thigh-high’s named Molly!
: And as further proof, I’ll have you know that I killed several gods just earlier today in a video game I was playing.
: So if that’s not enough reason for you to worship me, I don’t know what is.
: Are you...starting a cult or something?
: Yeah. But it’s a totally wholesome one and I’m not going to ask you to pray or donate or anything.
: We can just hang out, eat junk food, and watch movies.
: That...actually sounds like a pretty sweet deal.
: The sweetest deal, Sir.
: And where can I sign up for this so-called “Cult of Molly?”
: All I need is eight ounces of your blood. That is enough to perform the ritual.
: I’ll also need you to sign a few papers.
: I like to keep things organized, Sir. And without proper documentation for each and every member, things are bound to get wild.
: Just look at Christianity, Sir. There are like ten different kinds now. Would that really have happened if everyone had to sign a form?
: Uhh...Probably?
: Nonsense! Malarky!
: Real religion is like a gym membership. You sign up ‘cause you think it’s cool and then wind up forgetting about it and ultimately stop caring altogether.
: The Cult of Molly, though...That’s where things become different.
: Together, we’ll usher in the end of times! The last of days! The...ending of...stuff!
: You need to chill out with the energy drinks, Molly. Your enthusiasm is going to tear this place down.
: Let it burn for all I care! I’ll move in with you and Ami!
: You two would have to sleep in the same bed.
: I hope she likes cuddling, Sir. I tend to grab onto things when I sleep, you see.
: It’s a habit I’ve had since birth.
: I think it’s because I’m so full of love that it possesses me in my sleep.
: It's either that or a demon.
: It could be either one, Sir.
: That’s nice, Molly.
: Gah!
Molly’s cell phone suddenly rings from inside of her pocket, causing her to jump up in surprise.
: Who the heck is textin’ me at this time of night? Don’t they know that the latest update is supposed to drop in-
: AH! RIGHT NOW!
: Sir...I apologize for cutting this meeting short, but it appears that I have prior engagements.
: Go play your game, Molly. I’ll just find something else to do.
: Roger. Please feel free to visit me again soon, though!
: Preferably on a day where I don’t have games to play!
: How am I supposed to know when that is?
I wind up walking around the area surrounding the dorms for a few minutes afterward, hoping to bump into another familiar face.
Unfortunately, I don’t find anything and am forced to go home early...
Oh well, I guess.
At least Molly’s probably having a good night.
Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!
